packet.name: udp
pdus: 0-15: source port (optional), destination port, length (16 bits), checksum (16 bits), data

fields.name: source port
fields.description: optional field indicating the port of the sending process.

fields.name: destination port
fields.description: the port of the receiving process.

fields.name: length
fields.description: the length in octets of this user datagram including header and data. minimum value is eight.

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: the 16-bit one's complement of the one's complement sum of pseudo header, udp header, and data.

parsing context.name: ip header
parsing context.description: used to extract source address, destination address, protocol field, and udp length from the internet datagram.

transform functions.name: checksum calculation
transform functions.from: source address, destination address, protocol, udp length, udp header, data
transform functions.description: computes the checksum using one's complement sum of pseudo-header and data padded to multiple of two octets.
